applied_point: wheel link-frame axle origin; vertical tire contact line

parameters_used.coordinate_system: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; q1 yaw about +Z, q2/q3 about local -Y; zero links down

mass.coordinate_origin: Body hip yaw mount plane. Body bottom is z=-0.035m. All following COM positions use that frame.
mass.provenance: PROVISIONAL: latest OEM FL moving-link solids mirrored into four proper local leg frames; previous unchanged base allocation. Not a full collision-safe CAD export.

servo.model: Feetech STS3215 C018 12V assumed correct ordered variant
servo.provenance: Electrical endpoints from C018 datasheet research; linear voltage/torque-speed scaling, current approximation, delay, bandwidth, deadband, backlash, continuous/peak derating are unmeasured assumptions.

transmission.provenance: Design assumptions pending packaging and loaded reversal/deflection/efficiency measurement; motor travel is usable span around calibrated neutral, not absolute zero.

wheel_motor.provenance: Manufacturer reference, not selected purchase: GBP25.61 motor plus driver exceeds requested circa GBP15. Current cap is an unvalidated engineering assumption, not a published continuous rating. Simulation fields converted to wheel-axis torque/speed through the declared transmission; original motor fields preserved in wheel_axis_envelope_derivation.

environment.provenance: All assumed; stair geometry, floor grip, tire behavior and stair noses need measurement. No human or hardware measurements made.

simulation.provenance: Explicit controller and numerical assumptions, not identified STS firmware.

provisional_load_only.mirror: Local Y reflection for FR/RL; COM M*c and full tensor M*I*M^T. Proper world leg frames are supplied by URDF kinematics.
provisional_load_only.base_assumption: Body and base-fixed leg inventory unchanged from previous full export.

original_motor_parameters.provenance: Manufacturer reference, not selected purchase: GBP25.61 motor plus driver exceeds requested circa GBP15. Current cap is an unvalidated engineering assumption, not a published continuous rating.

wheel_axis_envelope_derivation.mapping: wheel torque=eta*ratio*motor torque; wheel speed=motor speed/ratio; electrical current fields unchanged
wheel_axis_envelope_derivation.limitations: Assumed efficiency and four-quadrant loss approximation. Shaft/input-gear spin inertia and gyroscopic coupling omitted; housing/link pose inertia retained.

hypothetical_gearing.commissioning_choice: One proposed static center per physical joint across oldworld targets reprojected to current geometry, currentfixture, neutral and flat reference. Old exact-angle assessment is preserved separately.
hypothetical_gearing.mass_and_tensor_assumption: Existing2:1 CAD inertials retained; new3:1 gear mass and clearance have not been designed.
hypothetical_gearing.efficiency_assumption: Existing efficiency/stiffness/backlash retained solely for sensitivity; extra stages or larger gears are not validated.

limitations: An ideal vertical force acts on one suspended wheel with the body fixed. This is a load fixture, not locomotion.
The wheel-axis load point and full-rate hold RMS differ from the older load_test.py COM-force/50Hz metrics.
Backlash, compliance, bandwidth, friction and continuous limits remain unmeasured assumptions.
